decision.explanation: The question asks for the population of Croydon Park without specifying a census year. The provided sources contain three distinct, valid population figures corresponding to different census years: 11,012 (2016 Census, supported by D1S7, D2S5, D3S1), 10,929 (2021 Census, supported by D2S5), and 3,998 (2011 Census, supported by D4S2, D5S1). As per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and avoid selecting a single 'winner' when distinct valid dates exist, all three values are included as complementary answers.
